name: SIDDHARTH VISHWAKARMA
bio:
Career Overview: Playing Style: A resilient player with a strong forehand, reliable serve, and tactical baseline game, effective on hard courts.
Career-High ATP Singles Ranking: #585 (August 5, 2024), Career-High ATP Doubles Ranking: #605 (January 13, 2020).
Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to play in a Grand Slam main draw.
Notable Achievements: ITF Success: Won 2 ITF Futures singles titles (2022 M15 Colombo, 2023 M15 Jakarta) and reached multiple semifinals (e.g., 2025 M15 Ahmedabad). National Titles: Two-time Fenesta National Champion (2018, 2022) and gold medalist at the 2023 National Games in Goa. Davis Cup & National Representation: Debuted for India in the Davis Cup World Group I tie against Sweden (September 2024), selected again for the February 2025 tie vs. Togo, though yet to play a live rubber.
Other Highlights: Overcame a six-year hiatus from tennis (2005-2013) due to financial constraints, resuming with coach Ratan Sharma’s support. Reached the final of the 2024 ITF M25 Addis Ababa and quarterfinals of the 2023 ITF M25 Lucknow (double bagel vs. Arthur Weber). Aims for a Top 300 ranking.
Siddharth’s journey from adversity to Davis Cup selection embodies perseverance in Indian tennis. 🎾🇮🇳
